title: ¡Rojito al rescate del gatito! 🚒🐱 | #shorts
world: sunny farm orchard: a very tall apple tree with red apples, a red barn and round golden hay bales + a dirt farm road between golden wheat fields
story: A tiny grey kitten clings to a branch high up in a tall apple tree and meows for help (emergency in second 0)
Rojito's siren flashes and he races down the farm road: nii-noo! (the rush)
He stops under the tree and looks up: the kitten is very, very high (the problem in scale)
His white ladder slides up and up until it touches the branch (the try)
At the top the kitten hugs the branch and shakes its head: it is too scared to climb down (obstacle)
The kitten slides down the slanted ladder like a slide, wiii! (twist: the ladder becomes a resbaladilla)
It lands in the soft hay next to its mother cat; both rub their heads on Rojito's bumper (thank you)
Top-down: the kitten runs straight back to the tree and starts climbing again, Rojito's eyes go wide (loop gag)
lyrics:
[Intro]
¡Miau, miau! ¡Ayuda, ayuda!
[Verse]
¡Nii-noo! ¡Rojito ya va!
¡Uy! ¡El gatito está muy arriba!
¡Sube y sube la escalera!
¡Miau! No se quiere bajar.
[Chorus]
¡Wiii! ¡Es una resbaladilla!
¡Con su mamá! ¡Gracias, Rojito!
[Outro]
¿Otra vez? ¡Miau, miau!

locations.huerto: A sunny farm orchard outdoors, vertical 9:16 composition, camera low at toy level: one very tall rounded apple tree full of green leaves and shiny red apples in the middle, soft green grass, a few round golden hay bales and a soft pile of loose golden hay under the tree, a cheerful red barn with white trim in the background, a wide open blue sky with white clouds. No vehicles in the orchard.
locations.camino: A sunny dirt farm road outdoors, vertical 9:16 composition, camera low at toy level: a smooth light-brown dirt road curving between golden wheat fields, a wooden fence along one side, a red barn far away on a soft green hill, a wide open blue sky with white clouds. No vehicles on the road.

shots: Extreme close-up high up in the tall apple tree: a tiny fluffy grey kitten with big glossy blue eyes clings with all four paws to a thin branch among green leaves and shiny red apples, its little mouth wide open meowing, the farm far below and blurred.
The tiny kitten clings to the branch and meows, the branch sways gently.

Low side view at ground level on the dirt farm road: the little red fire truck character drives fast from left to right, his round blue siren FLASHING BRIGHT BLUE with glowing light rays, a little cloud of dust behind his wheels, golden wheat fields behind.
He drives quickly along the road, his siren flashing, dust puffing behind his wheels.

Wide shot of the sunny farm orchard: the little red fire truck character stopped at the foot of the very tall apple tree, tilting his cab back and looking up with big surprised eyes, and the tiny grey kitten very small high up on a branch near the top of the tree.
He tilts his cab back and looks up at the kitten high in the tree, blinking.

View from behind and below the little red fire truck character: his white ladder is now EXTENDED very long, rising from his roof in a straight slanted line up into the apple tree, its top rung resting on the branch next to the tiny grey kitten.
The long white ladder slowly slides a little higher until its top rung rests on the branch.

Close-up at the top of the long white ladder in the apple tree: the tiny grey kitten hugs the branch tightly with its ears down and shakes its head, the top rung of the white ladder right next to its paws, red apples and green leaves around.
The kitten hugs the branch and shakes its little head, its ears down.

Side view of the whole long white ladder slanting from the little red fire truck's roof up into the apple tree: the tiny grey kitten SLIDES DOWN the ladder on its tummy like a playground slide, front paws stretched forward, eyes happy, halfway down.
The kitten slides smoothly down the slanted ladder toward the ground, happy.

Medium shot, front three-quarter view under the apple tree: the tiny grey kitten sits in a soft pile of golden hay next to a fluffy grey mother cat, and both rub their heads lovingly against the front bumper of the smiling little red fire truck character.
The kitten and its mother rub their heads on his bumper and he smiles happily.

Top-down view from above the orchard: the tiny grey kitten runs across the green grass straight back to the trunk of the tall apple tree and starts to climb it again, the little red fire truck character beside the tree looking at it with wide surprised eyes.
The kitten scampers to the tree trunk and starts climbing, he watches with wide eyes.

hero.who: The little red fire truck character
hero.one: Only one vehicle character in the picture.

style: High-end 3D animated preschool cartoon style, soft rounded toy-like shapes, smooth matte clay-like materials, soft studio lighting with a warm key light, pastel but saturated colors, big expressive glossy eyes, cute and friendly, clean composition, high quality render.
lock: ROJITO, a cute little red toy fire truck character with a friendly face: a short chubby rounded body like a toddler toy, shiny cherry-red paint, a big curved windshield with two big glossy dark-brown cartoon eyes with white sparkle highlights and expressive eyebrows, a small smiling mouth on the front bumper, rosy pink cheeks on the front, a small white ladder on the roof, one round blue siren light on top, a golden bell on the front, a small number 1 in a yellow circle on each door.
twist: the kitten is too scared to climb down the ladder, so the ladder turns into a slide: the kitten slides down on its tummy, wiii! — the rescue becomes a game
experiment: first rescue_mission (KORIRI rescue vehicles 4.2M ×450, PequeGenios rescue ×1,027) + first animal friend for Rojito; the extending ladder is the hero's 'power'
continuity: sunny midday in every shot; Rojito cherry red; siren FLASHING in R2 only (dark blue in R1, R3-R8); ladder short on the roof in R2-R3, EXTENDED long from R4 to R6, short again in R7-R8; kitten grey with blue eyes: on the high branch R1, R3, R5, on the ladder R6, in the hay R7, climbing the trunk R8; mother cat only in R7; huerto = all shots except R2 (camino)
